DeepSeek pet character images

Source: https://github.com/Cayhaze/deepseek-pet
Original paths: renderer/assets/front.png, happy.png, shy.png, wry.png
Upstream package author field: TraeWork
The upstream README and package.json declare the MIT license.
Retrieved 2026-11-03. Images are retained unmodified.

Additional project assets: eating-rice.gif and eating-rice.png were generated
using the built-in imagegen tool from a user-provided eating-rice reference.
They were not downloaded from the upstream repository. The source keyframe
sheet, prompt, and export script are kept in design/big-fat-fish-rice-sheet.png,
design/big-fat-fish-rice-prompt.txt, and scripts/build-fish-rice.mjs.
